svg.aria-label: Explainer: a 5-minute cache holds your Claude Code session. A small fix is 1.5x while the cache is warm (n=5). After the cache expires, the history is sent again and the same fix is about 10x (n=5). /compact before a break makes the miss 2.5x (n=3). Before a break, /compact. After a break, /clear plus a 3-line note. Inside 5 minutes, just continue. Independent study. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
svg.title: A 10-minute break makes a small Claude Code fix use 10 times as much

g.text: Same small fix, cache still warm. 1.5x · n=5
You step away. The 5-minute cache starts to expire.
The cache expired. It is empty.
The history is sent again. ~10x · n=5
Independent study. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
A break past 5 minutes can make the next fix use 10x.
